reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Exertional and classic heat cooks brains dry for evaporative cooling while hypothermic Osborn humps warn gentle rewarm with prolonged arrest efforts; drowned lungs need PEEP ARDS nets and high climbers descend HAPE and HACE with nifedipine and dexamethasone bridges.
additionalDifferentials: Sepsis versus stroke versus MI versus epilepsy by cultures imaging troponins and witnesses
Heatstroke versus sepsis by anhidrosis cores and cultures
HAPE versus pneumonia versus PE by ascent speed and CT
